boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented campus spaces with distinct setups for quiet work, group sessions, computers, or a reset between classes.

cards.title: Settle into The Bird Cage
cards.subtitle: Baugher Student Center
cards.notes: Use this Baugher Student Center common room for a calm solo work session; the College describes it as a place to relax and study in peace.
cards.short_summary: A student-center common room for quiet individual work.
cards.evidence_claim: Elizabethtown College identifies The Bird Cage as a Baugher Student Center common room where students can relax and study in peace.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Baugher Student Center; confirm building access and availability on arrival.

cards.title: Work at The Learning Zone
cards.subtitle: Second floor, Brossman Commons
cards.notes: Head to the second floor of Brossman Commons when you want a dedicated study area rather than an informal lounge seat.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated study space in Brossman Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: Elizabethtown College states that The Learning Zone has a dedicated study space on the second floor of Brossman Commons.
cards.access_notes: Second floor of Brossman Commons; check the building’s current access conditions.

cards.title: Reserve a High Library Study Room
cards.subtitle: High Library
cards.notes: Choose a time slot through the library reservation system for group work; unreserved rooms can also be used on a drop-in basis.
cards.short_summary: Reservable rooms with a drop-in option when unbooked.
cards.evidence_claim: The College says students can reserve High Library study rooms by availability, and may use unreserved rooms on a drop-in basis.
cards.access_notes: Reserve through the High Library website or library kiosks; availability is first come, first served.

cards.title: Take a Focus Break in The Relaxation Room
cards.subtitle: The Well, second floor of Bowers Center
cards.notes: Use the comfortable chairs for a low-key reset or light reading; reserve the Sleep Pod separately if you want its 20-minute session.
cards.short_summary: A wellness-oriented room with chairs and a reservable Sleep Pod.
cards.evidence_claim: The College describes The Well’s Relaxation Room as a relaxation/study space with comfortable chairs and a Sleep Pod reservable for 20 minutes.
cards.access_notes: Located in The Well on Bowers Center’s second floor; reserve the Sleep Pod through the Bowers Center website.

cards.title: Use Psychology Computer Lab E260H
cards.subtitle: Esbenshade Hall
cards.notes: Bring computer-based work to E260H when no class is scheduled; ask Psychology faculty about E263 if you need the alternate lab space.
cards.short_summary: A class-schedule-dependent computer lab for study work.
cards.evidence_claim: Elizabethtown College says Psychology Computer Lab E260H is available when it is not in use for class, with E263 available by asking Psychology faculty.
cards.access_notes: Available only when no class is meeting; E263 access requires asking Psychology faculty.

cards.title: Gather in OT Student Commons E381
cards.subtitle: Third floor, Esbenshade Hall
cards.notes: Occupational Therapy students can use the commons for table work or a longer session, with comfortable seating plus a mini refrigerator and microwave.
cards.short_summary: An OT-focused commons with study seating and basic amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: The College describes OT Student Commons E381 as having comfortable chairs, tables and chairs, a small refrigerator, and a mini microwave.
cards.access_notes: Third floor of Esbenshade Hall; this is described by the College as an Occupational Therapy student space.

cards.title: Review Notes in Chemistry Library M102
cards.subtitle: Masters Center
cards.notes: Use M102 for chemistry-focused reading or problem sets with tables, comfortable chairs, reference books, and a whiteboard available.
cards.short_summary: A chemistry study room with reference material and a whiteboard.
cards.evidence_claim: Elizabethtown College lists Chemistry Library M102 with tables and chairs, comfortable chairs, reference books, and a whiteboard.
cards.access_notes: Chemistry-focused space; verify current room availability before using it.

cards.title: Compute in Chemistry Computer Lab M231
cards.subtitle: Masters Center
cards.notes: Plan computer-heavy coursework in M231, which the College lists as open 24/7; keep the shared lab ready for the next user.
cards.short_summary: A Chemistry computer lab listed as open around the clock.
cards.evidence_claim: Elizabethtown College states that the Chemistry Computer Lab, M231, is open 24/7.
cards.access_notes: The College lists M231 as open 24/7; follow current building-access policies and lab rules.

cards.title: Sketch It Out in the Biology Study Area
cards.subtitle: Second floor, Lyet Hall
cards.notes: Use the tables, comfortable chairs, reference books, and whiteboards on Lyet’s second floor for biology reading, diagrams, and review.
cards.short_summary: A biology department space equipped for reading and whiteboard work.
cards.evidence_claim: The College says the Biology Department study area on Lyet Hall’s second floor has tables and chairs, comfortable chairs, reference books, and whiteboards.
cards.access_notes: Second floor of Lyet Hall; verify current access and avoid interrupting departmental activity.

cards.title: Read Quietly in Nicarry
cards.subtitle: Second floor, Nicarry Hall
cards.notes: Choose the second-floor quiet study lounge for independent reading or focused writing; the College identifies it as available to all students.
cards.short_summary: An all-student quiet study lounge in Nicarry Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Elizabethtown College states that all students can use the quiet study lounge on the second floor of Nicarry Hall.
cards.access_notes: Second floor of Nicarry Hall; intended by the College as a quiet study lounge for all students.
